notes: Self-declared Brookhaven RP with six claimable house lots is the Life preset on settlement-claimable, confirmed by the author choosing pre-built houses with customizable yards over player-built homes. Simulation is named second because the job gear racks and the emergency-vehicle spawner are a defined, repeatable task loop rather than open-ended roleplay, and that is what makes trigger-task available for the racks and garage. On top of the preset I added the stated central town square park as social-hub, the sidewalks as path-street, and the few-blocks-per-quadrant city as settlement-density. Decided without a user: this is one continuous compact map so it stays off P4, and I did not add P2 for the two-story school since nothing overhangs the outdoor play surface and its upper floor is generated inside the P3 interior pass.
